reviewReason: Exercise concurrent Go resource aliases and retained ownership controls in the pinned native Go runtime; no signed guest claim.

steps.name: Check ordinary concurrent close and the existing ownership contract
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-owner-close"
sha256sum sdk/go-guest/ownership/owner.go sdk/go-guest/ownership/owner_test.go > "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-owner-close/source.sha256"
go version | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-owner-close/go-version.log"
go test -race -count=1 -v ./sdk/go-guest/ownership 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-owner-close/owner-tests.log"
grep -F -- '--- PASS: TestConcurrentAliasCloseIsIdempotent' "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-owner-close/owner-tests.log"
sha256sum --check --strict "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-owner-close/source.sha256"
